Site Name: Waste caught on weir piers by the old bridge
Description: Row of brick-faced piers (a weir) beside the old road bridge, with plastic sheets, cloth and branches caught against the piers; still, dark water. Litter on the bank by the gate (18.676867, 73.893975)
Source: Field visit 9 Oct 2026 (GPS Map Camera photos)
Jurisdiction (who owns this spot): Alandi Municipal Council (to confirm with the ward map)
Notes / To Verify: Who owns and operates this weir is unknown (RTI to the council and WRD). One team photo from this spot shows a face and stays in the log book only

Site Name: Weir with green water and froth, Kate Patil Nagar
Description: Water spilling over a weir (concrete piers with a pipe rail on top); strongly yellow-green on one side of the spillway, white froth below; plastic on the rocks. Froth patch and dark water downstream (18.677457, 73.889959)
Source: Field visit 9 Oct 2026 (GPS Map Camera photos)
Jurisdiction (who owns this spot): Alandi Municipal Council (to confirm); weir owner unknown
Notes / To Verify: Green colour is consistent with algae in a nutrient-rich weir pool, but that is an inference; only MPCB sampling can say what it is. Foam here is the subject of NGT OA 111/2024 (WZ)

Site Name: Possible drain entering from the opposite bank
Description: Dark water flowing across the mudflat from an opening in the stone ghat wall on the opposite bank
Source: Field visit 9 Oct 2026 (GPS Map Camera photo)
Jurisdiction (who owns this spot): To confirm: the opposite bank may be outside Alandi council limits (Charholi/PCMC side or a village)

Site Name: Plastic and cloth waste on the riverbed under the Dighi–Alandi Road bridge
Description: Plastic bags, cloth and other waste on the rocks and in the shallow water under the Dighi–Alandi Road bridge, just downstream of the brick-pier weir (CS-01); dark, still water between the piers
Source: Field visit 9 Oct 2026 (GPS Map Camera photo)
Jurisdiction (who owns this spot): Alandi Municipal Council (to confirm with the ward map); who maintains the bridge (PWD or council) unknown
Notes / To Verify: Same weir and bridge as CS-01, about 65 m east. Photo taken from the bank under the bridge; a person on the bridge is blurred in the website copy
